name: api-gateway-openapi-spec-authoring
description: Writes, migrates, and fixes OpenAPI specs for Google Cloud API Gateway. Use when converting an OpenAPI 2.0 (Swagger) spec to OpenAPI 3.x, writing a new OpenAPI 3.x spec, or fixing a failed "gcloud api-gateway api-configs create", such as "extension is only supported in OpenAPI 2.x". Also use when quotas set with x-google-quota are never enforced, or when a backend receives path parameters as query parameters. Don't use for adding or debugging MCP tools (use api-gateway-mcp-server), adding or changing API key, JWT, or quota settings in a working spec, or backend lockdown (use api-gateway-backend-security-and-rate-limiting), failing requests or service account and concurrency errors (use api-gateway-troubleshooting), Cloud Endpoints, Apigee, or GKE Gateway API.
